name: Woody - Helping a Friend
en:
HANG ON! When you play this character, choose
one of the following. If you have another Toy
character in play, choose both instead:
• You may return a character card with cost 2 or less
from your discard to your hand.
• You may play a character with cost 2 or less for free.
zh:
撐住！　當你打出這個角色時，選擇下列一項。若你另有一個玩具角色在場，改為兩項都選：
• 你可以將一張費用 2 或以下的角色卡從棄牌堆移回手牌。
• 你可以免費打出一個費用 2 或以下的角色。

name: Ming Lee - Proud Parent
en:
BIGGEST FAN If you have a character named
Meilin Lee in play, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this
character.

you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this character.

name: Pocahontas - Guiding the Tribe
en:
STAY CLOSE When you play this character, you
may play a character with cost 1 for free.
zh: 靠近點　當你打出這個角色時，你可以免費打出一個費用 1 的角色。

name: Vixey - Expert Fisher

have a character with Evasive in play, you may return
chosen character, item, or location with cost 2 or

zh: 潛入　當你打出這個角色時，若你有一個具迴避的角色在場，你可以將一個費用 2 或以下的指定角色、物品或地點移回其持有者的手牌。

characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)

name: Buzz Lightyear - Providing Cover
en:
ACTION FIGURE When you play this character, choose
one of the following. If you have another Toy character
in play, choose both instead:

pay 1 ⬡ to ready chosen character of yours. They
can't quest or challenge for the rest of this turn.

en:

discard. If you do, they enter play exerted. (You

專注能量　這個角色可以橫置進場，來抽一張牌。
召喚　在你的回合中，每當你另一個角色橫置進場時，你可以抽一張牌。

name: Mrs. Incredible - Created by the Vine
en:
TORRENT Whenever one of your Floodborn
characters quests, you pay 1 ⬡ less for the next
character you shift this turn.
zh: 奔流　每當你一個 Floodborn 角色探險時，你本回合變身的下一個角色少支付 1 ⬡。

name: Pete - Created by the Vine
en:
THORNY OVERGROWTH Your Floodborn characters
gain Challenger +1. (They get +1 ¤ while challenging.)
zh: 荊棘蔓生　你的 Floodborn 角色獲得挑戰者 +1。（他們挑戰時獲得 +1 ¤。）

name: Grandma Wu - Wise Grandmother
en:
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character
gets +2 ¤.)
ANCESTRAL UNDERSTANDING When you shift a
character on top of this character, gain 1 lore.
zh:
挑戰者 +2（挑戰時，這個角色獲得 +2 ¤。）
先祖智慧　當你將一個角色變身到這個角色上時，獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: HeiHei - Created by the Vine
en:
BOTANICAL REMEDY Whenever one of your Floodborn
characters quests, you may move 1 damage from
chosen character to chosen opposing character.
zh: 植物療方　每當你一個 Floodborn 角色探險時，你可以將 1 點傷害從指定角色移到指定的對方角色。

name: Hera - Created by the Vine
en:
MYSTICAL BOON Whenever you play this or
another Floodborn character, gain 1 lore.
zh: 神秘恩賜　每當你打出這個或另一個 Floodborn 角色時，獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Morph - Little Imitator
en:
ADVANCED MIMICRY You can shift any character
on top of this character. (This includes all Shift
variants.)
zh: 進階模仿　你可以將任何角色變身到這個角色上。（包含所有變身變體。）

name: Peter Pan - Playful Prankster
en:
STAY RIGHT THERE When you play this character,
chosen opposing character can't ready at the
start of their next turn.
zh: 待在那裡　當你打出這個角色時，指定的對方角色在其下個回合開始時不能準備。

name: Aladdin & Genie - Mischievous Pals
en:
Shift 3 ⬡ (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Aladdin or Genie.)
SLEIGHT OF HAND When you play this character,
you may put any number of cards from your hand
on the bottom of your deck in any order. If you
do, draw that number of cards plus 1.
zh:
變身 3 ⬡（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Aladdin 或 Genie 的角色上。）
手法靈巧　當你打出這個角色時，你可以將手牌中任意數量的卡以任意順序放到你牌庫底。若你這麼做，抽取該數量再加 1 張牌。

name: Peter Pan & Tinker Bell - Fast Friends
en:
Shift 4 ⬡ (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top
of one of your characters named Peter Pan or
Tinker Bell.)
YOU CAN FLY! Your characters gain Evasive. (Only
characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
zh:
變身 4 ⬡（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Peter Pan 或 Tinker Bell 的角色上。）
你會飛！　你的角色獲得迴避。（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰他們。）

name: Christopher Robin - Hunny Sage
en:
GATHER THE PARTY You can have other Hunny
characters in your deck regardless of ink type.
MAGICAL SUMMONS When you play this character,
you may search your deck for a Hunny card, reveal it,
and put it in your hand. If you do, shuffle your deck.
zh:
召集隊伍　你的牌庫中可以放入其他 Hunny 角色，不受墨水類型限制。
魔法召喚　當你打出這個角色時，你可以在你的牌庫中搜尋一張 Hunny 卡，展示它並加入手牌。若你這麼做，洗你的牌庫。

name: Winnie the Pooh & Piglet - Hunny Mages
en:
Shift 3 ⬡ (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top
of one of your characters named Winnie the Pooh
or Piglet.)
MAGICAL MIX This character gets +1 ◊ for each
different ink type of characters you have in play.
zh:
變身 3 ⬡（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Winnie the Pooh 或 Piglet 的角色上。）
魔法混合　你在場的角色每有一種不同的墨水類型，這個角色就獲得 +1 ◊。

name: Maleficent & Diablo - Evil Incarnate
en:
Shift 5 ⬡ (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Maleficent or Diablo.)
FOOLS! You may put 5 character cards from your discard
on the bottom of your deck in any order to shift this
character for free.
RAVEN'S CALL During your turn, whenever this character
exerts, draw a card.
zh:
變身 5 ⬡（你可以支付 5 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Maleficent 或 Diablo 的角色上。）
愚蠢的傢伙！　你可以將棄牌堆中 5 張角色卡以任意順序放到牌庫底，來免費變身這個角色。
烏鴉的呼喚　在你的回合中，每當這個角色橫置時，抽一張牌。

name: You've Got Some Punch
en:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Chosen character gains Rush and Challenger +2 this
turn. (They can challenge the turn they're played. They
get +2 ¤ while challenging.)
zh:
（費用 2 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
指定角色本回合獲得突襲和挑戰者 +2。（他們在被打出的回合就能挑戰。他們挑戰時獲得 +2 ¤。）

name: With a Few Good Friends
en:
Sing Together 6 (Any number of your or your teammates'
characters with total cost 6 or more may ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Chosen player draws a card for each different ink type
of characters you have in play.
zh:
合唱 6（你或隊友的角色，任意數量、費用合計 6 或以上，可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
指定玩家依你在場角色的不同墨水類型數量抽取對應數量的牌。

name: Petrify
en: Exert chosen opposing character.
zh: 橫置指定的對方角色。

name: One and Only
en:
Choose a character. Banish all other characters with
the same name as that character.
zh: 選擇一個角色。消滅所有其他與該角色同名的角色。

name: Protective Aura
en:
Your Floodborn characters gain Evasive until the start
of your next turn. (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge them.)
zh: 你的 Floodborn 角色獲得迴避，直到你的下個回合開始。（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰他們。）

name: Narrow Escape
en:
Return up to 2 chosen characters, items, or locations
with cost 2 or less each to their player's hand.
zh: 將至多 2 個各費用 2 或以下的指定角色、物品或地點移回其持有者的手牌。

name: Broken Pod
en:
RENEWAL PROCESS ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Put a card from chosen
player's discard on the bottom of their deck.
zh: 更新程序　⟳，1 ⬡ — 將一張卡從指定玩家的棄牌堆放到其牌庫底。

name: Magical Hunny Staff
en:
GIFT OF THE HIVE Once during your turn, you may pay 1 ⬡
to give chosen character of yours the Hunny classification
until the start of your next turn.
SPELL OF SWIFTNESS ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Chosen Hunny character
of yours gains Evasive until the start of your next turn.
(Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
zh:
蜂巢的恩賜　你回合中一次，你可以支付 1 ⬡ 給予你一個指定角色 Hunny 分類，直到你的下個回合開始。
迅捷咒語　⟳，2 ⬡ — 你一個指定的 Hunny 角色獲得迴避，直到你的下個回合開始。（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰他們。）

name: Source of the Vine
en:
SIPHON Whenever an opposing character quests, you
gain 1 lore unless their player pays 1 ⬡.
RADIANT BLOOM ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Gain 1 lore.
zh:
汲取　每當對方角色探險時，除非其持有者支付 1 ⬡，否則你獲得 1 點傳說值。
燦爛綻放　⟳，2 ⬡ — 獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Ring of Stones - Taken by the Vine
en: DEEP WISDOM Your Floodborn characters get +1 ◊.
zh: 深邃智慧　你的 Floodborn 角色獲得 +1 ◊。

name: Carl Fredricksen - Loving Husband
en:
TAKE MY HAND When you play this character, you
pay 2 ⬡ less for the next character named Ellie
Fredricksen you play this turn.
zh: 牽我的手　當你打出這個角色時，你本回合打出的下一個名為 Ellie Fredricksen 的角色少支付 2 ⬡。

name: Ellie Fredricksen - Loving Wife
en:
ADVENTUROUS HEART Whenever you play a
location, gain 1 lore.
zh: 冒險之心　每當你打出一個地點時，獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Buzz Lightyear - Grounded
en: NOT A FLYING TOY This character can't gain Evasive.
zh: 不是會飛的玩具　這個角色不能獲得迴避。

name: Buzz Lightyear - Providing Cover
en:
ACTION FIGURE When you play this character,
choose one of the following. If you have another Toy
character in play, choose both instead:
• You may return an action card with cost 2 or less
from your discard to your hand.
• You may play an action with cost 2 or less for free.
zh:
玩具人偶　當你打出這個角色時，選擇下列一項。若你另有一個玩具角色在場，改為兩項都選：
• 你可以將一張費用 2 或以下的行動卡從棄牌堆移回手牌。
• 你可以免費打出一個費用 2 或以下的行動。

name: Gopher - Hunny Cook
en:
DOWN THE HOLE This character may enter play
exerted.
FORTIFYING MEAL During an opponent's turn,
while this character is exerted, your other Hunny
characters gain Resist +1. (Damage dealt to them
is reduced by 1.)
zh:
鑽進洞裡　這個角色可以橫置進場。
加固餐點　在對手的回合中，當這個角色橫置時，你其他的 Hunny 角色獲得抵抗 +1。（對他們造成的傷害減少 1。）

name: Russell - Senior Wilderness Explorer
en:
Shift 3 ⬡ (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Russell.)
BASE CAMP Your characters at locations get +1 ¤.
GOOD LEADERSHIP Whenever one of your
characters with 4 ¤ or more quests, gain 1 lore.
zh:
變身 3 ⬡（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Russell 的角色上。）
大本營　你在地點的角色獲得 +1 ¤。
優秀領導　每當你一個 4 ¤ 或以上的角色探險時，獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Rapunzel - Tower Defender
en:
THE FATES' DESIGN When you play this character,
you may choose and discard a card. If you do,
return chosen character to their player's hand.
zh: 命運的安排　當你打出這個角色時，你可以選擇並棄掉一張卡。若你這麼做，將指定角色移回其持有者的手牌。

name: Tod - Clever Fox
en:
PROBLEM SOLVING When you play this character,
draw 2 cards, then choose and discard a card.
zh: 解決問題　當你打出這個角色時，抽兩張牌，然後選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: Russell - Junior Wilderness Explorer
en:
ASSISTING THE ELDERLY BADGE Whenever this
character quests, you may move him and one of your
other characters to the same location for free.
zh: 協助長者徽章　每當這個角色探險時，你可以將他和你另一個角色免費移動到同一個地點。

name: Roo - Hunny Rogue
en:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except
to challenge.)
ELUSIVE EXPERTISE While you have another Hunny
character in play, this character gains Evasive. (Only
characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
zh:
守護（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇這個角色。）
難以捉摸　當你另有一個 Hunny 角色在場時，這個角色獲得迴避。（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰他們。）

name: Winifred - Exasperated Elephant
en:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
zh: 守護（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇這個角色。）

name: Aladdin - Doing His Part
en:
CLEAR IT OUT When you play this character, you
may pay 1 ⬡ to banish chosen item.
zh: 清理乾淨　當你打出這個角色時，你可以支付 1 ⬡ 消滅指定的物品。

name: Madam Mim - Hummingbird
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge
this character.)
JUST HOW I LIKE IT All cards in your hand count as
having ◉.
zh:
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
這正合我意　你手牌中所有卡都視為具有 ◉。

name: Kevin - Flightless Bird
en:
BACK TO THE NEST Whenever this character
quests, put this card on the top of your deck.
zh: 回到巢中　每當這個角色探險時，將這張卡放到你牌庫頂。

name: Peter Pan - Created by the Vine
en:
CLEVER TRICK Whenever one of your Floodborn
characters is challenged, the challenging player
chooses and discards a card.
zh: 巧妙詭計　每當你一個 Floodborn 角色被挑戰時，進行挑戰的玩家選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: Posey - Vampire Potato
en:
Potato Shift 5 ⬡ (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this
on top of one of your items named Potato.)
zh: Potato 變身 5 ⬡（你可以支付 5 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Potato 的物品上。）

name: Dr. Bushroot - Evil Botanist
en:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
FAIR IS FAIR Whenever this character is challenged,
chosen opponent chooses and discards a card.
zh:
守護（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇這個角色。）
公平就是公平　每當這個角色被挑戰時，指定對手選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: Mother Gothel - Evil as Ever
zh: 媽咪回來了　在你的回合中，當你棄掉這張卡時，你可以從你的棄牌堆打出這個角色。（你支付所有費用。）

name: Tod & Copper - Best of Friends
en:
Shift 2 ⬡ (You may pay 2 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Tod or Copper.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge
this character.)
zh:
變身 2 ⬡（你可以支付 2 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Tod 或 Copper 的角色上。）
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）

name: Rapunzel - Escaping the Tower
en:
THE CALL OF ADVENTURE Once during your turn,
you may discard a card to give this character +1 ◊
and Evasive until the start of your next turn. (Only
characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
zh: 冒險的召喚　你回合中一次，你可以棄掉一張卡，給予這個角色 +1 ◊ 和迴避，直到你的下個回合開始。（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰他們。）

name: Mushu - Stealthy Dragon
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge
this character.)
TIP THE SCALES Whenever this character quests,
if an opponent has more cards in their hand than
you, you may draw a card.
zh:
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
扭轉局勢　每當這個角色探險時，若對手手牌比你多，你可以抽一張牌。

name: Carl Fredricksen & Russell - Intrepid Explorers
en:
Shift 4 ⬡ (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Carl Fredricksen or Russell.)
OUTDOOR SKILLS While this character is at a location,
all characters at that location get +1 ◊ and gain Evasive.
(Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
zh:
變身 4 ⬡（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Carl Fredricksen 或 Russell 的角色上。）
野外技能　當這個角色在地點時，該地點的所有角色獲得 +1 ◊ 並獲得迴避。（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰他們。）

name: Mickey Mouse & Minnie Mouse - Adventuring Duo
en:
Duo Shift 0 ⬡ (You may pay 0 ⬡ to play this on
top of two of your characters, one named Mickey
Mouse and one named Minnie Mouse.)
THINKING OF YOU If this character would be
banished, put them into your inkwell facedown
and exerted instead.
zh:
雙人變身 0 ⬡（你可以支付 0 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你兩個角色上，一個名為 Mickey Mouse、一個名為 Minnie Mouse。）
想念你　若這個角色將被消滅，改為將他們牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。

name: Rapunzel & Flynn Rider - Unlikely Pair
en:
Shift 3 ⬡ (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Rapunzel or Flynn Rider.)
CLEVER SWAP Whenever this character quests, you may
draw a card, then choose and discard a card.
FRESH START During your turn, whenever you discard
a character card, you may play that character from your
discard. (You pay all costs.)
zh:
變身 3 ⬡（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Rapunzel 或 Flynn Rider 的角色上。）
巧妙交換　每當這個角色探險時，你可以抽一張牌，然後選擇並棄掉一張卡。
重新開始　在你的回合中，每當你棄掉一張角色卡時，你可以從你的棄牌堆打出那個角色。（你支付所有費用。）

name: To Wither a Flower
en:
(A character with cost 4 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Deal 2 damage to each opposing damaged character.
zh:
（費用 4 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
對每個對方的受傷角色造成 2 點傷害。

name: Piercing Attack
en:
Deal 2 damage to chosen character. This damage can't
be reduced by Resist.
zh: 對指定角色造成 2 點傷害。這個傷害不能被抵抗減少。

name: Put That Thing Back
en:
(A character with cost 4 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Return chosen character or item to their player's hand.
zh:
（費用 4 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
將指定的角色或物品移回其持有者的手牌。

name: Scout Ahead
en: If an opponent has more lore than you, gain 2 lore.
zh: 若對手的傳說值比你多，獲得 2 點傳說值。

name: Potato
en: FULL OF POTENTIAL This item enters play exerted.
zh: 充滿潛力　這個物品橫置進場。

name: My Adventure Book
en:
NEW MEMORIES ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Reveal the top card of your deck.
If it's a non-character card or a character card named Kevin,
put it into your hand. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of
your deck.
zh: 新的回憶　⟳，1 ⬡ — 展示你牌庫頂的卡。若它是非角色卡或名為 Kevin 的角色卡，將它加入手牌；否則，將它放到你牌庫底。

name: Vine Pod
en:
FRAGILE HUSK This item enters play exerted.
REGENERATE ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Banish chosen character of
yours. You may play a character with the same name as
that character for free.
zh:
脆弱外殼　這個物品橫置進場。
再生　⟳，1 ⬡ — 消滅你一個指定角色。你可以免費打出一個與該角色同名的角色。

name: Paradise Falls - Exotic Destination
en: QUITE A SIGHT While you have a character here, this location gets +3 ◊.
zh: 壯麗景觀　當你有一個角色在這裡時，這個地點獲得 +3 ◊。

name: Dash Parr - Super Fast
en:
Shift 3 ⬡ (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Dash Parr.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
FOLLOW ME! Whenever this character quests, you may
reveal the top card of your deck. If you do, you may play it.
Otherwise, put it into your discard. (You pay all costs.)
zh:
變身 3 ⬡（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Dash Parr 的角色上。）
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
跟我來！　每當這個角色探險時，你可以展示你牌庫頂的卡。若你這麼做，你可以打出它；否則，將它放入你的棄牌堆。（你支付所有費用。）

name: Yzma - Choosy Customer
en:
GET THIS RIGHT When you play this character,
each opponent loses 1 lore.
zh: 把這件事做對　當你打出這個角色時，每位對手失去 1 點傳說值。

name: The Bear - Territorial Animal
en:
SAVAGE FURY While this character has damage,
he gets +3 ¤.
zh: 野性狂暴　當這個角色有傷害時，他獲得 +3 ¤。

name: Carl Fredricksen - On the Move
en:
MOVING PARTNER Whenever you play a location,
you may move this character and up to 1 of your
other characters to that location for free.
ADVENTURE AWAITS Whenever this character
quests while at a location, draw cards equal to
that location's ◊.
zh:
搬運夥伴　每當你打出一個地點時，你可以將這個角色和你至多 1 個其他角色免費移動到該地點。
冒險在等待　每當這個角色在地點探險時，依該地點的 ◊ 抽取對應數量的牌。

name: Dash Parr - Dodgeball Dynamo
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge
this character.)
zh: 迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）

name: Gaston - Created by the Vine
en:
DRAWING STRENGTH Your Floodborn characters
get +1 ¤.
zh: 汲取力量　你的 Floodborn 角色獲得 +1 ¤。

name: Colonel Hathi - On the March
en:
HUP, TWO, THREE, FOUR Whenever this character

name: Grandma Wu - Fierce Red Panda

Temporary Shift 4 ⬡ (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on

臨時變身 4 ⬡（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Grandma Wu 的角色上。在你的回合結束時，移除這個角色身上所有傷害，並只將這張卡移回你的手牌。）

Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge
this character.)

魯莽（這個角色不能探險，且每回合若有能力必須挑戰。）

Rush (This character can challenge the turn they're

突襲（這個角色在被打出的回合就能挑戰。）

FEARSOME GLARE When you play this character, you

臨時變身 7 ⬡（你可以支付 7 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Ming Lee 的角色上。在你的回合結束時，移除這個角色身上所有傷害，並只將這張卡移回你的手牌。）
毀滅之路　每當這個角色挑戰另一個角色時，準備她。她本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。

name: Captain Hook - Conniving Pirate

HAVE AT YOU Whenever this character challenges
another character, gain 1 lore.
zh: 接招　每當這個角色挑戰另一個角色時，獲得 1 點傳說值。

Shift 6 ⬡ (You may pay 6 ⬡ to play this on top of

變身 6 ⬡（你可以支付 6 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Belle 或 Beast 的角色上。）
鼓舞之舞　每當這個角色探險時，準備你墨水池中所有卡。
感激的觀眾　6 ⬡ — 準備你其他的角色。他們本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。

Combo Shift 6 ⬡ (You may pay 6 ⬡ to play this on

迴避、抵抗 +1
不可思議的戰術　每當這個角色探險或挑戰時，其下方每有一張卡就抽一張牌。

zh: 消滅一個 3 ¤ 或以下的指定角色。若你有一個怪獸角色在場，指定對手失去 1 點傳說值。

zh: 洗你的牌庫，然後展示牌庫頂的卡。若它是行動卡，你可以免費打出它；否則，將它放到你牌庫底，然後每位對手失去 1 點傳說值，你獲得 1 點傳說值。

飄走　當你打出這個物品時，選擇你一個地點。當這個物品在場時，該地點獲得迴避。（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰它。）

小把戲　當你打出這個角色時，你可以從你牌庫底抽一張牌。

whenever he quests, put the top 4 cards of your

zh: 邪惡設計　當你打出這個角色時以及每當他探險時，將你牌庫頂 4 張卡放入棄牌堆。以此方式每有一張物品卡放入你的棄牌堆，你可以對指定角色造成 1 點傷害。

zh: 嚮往更多　你將一個角色變身到這個角色上時少支付 1 ⬡。

and exerted.

滾出去！　當你打出這個角色時，將你一個指定角色牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。

USEFUL GEAR Whenever you play an item, look at the top

you may reveal it and put it into your hand to gain 3 lore.
Otherwise, put it on either the top or the bottom of your deck.

有用的裝備　每當你打出一個物品時，查看你牌庫頂的卡。將它放到你牌庫頂或牌庫底。
